most_supported_hypothesis: Switching-correlated ADC measurement contamination through an unguarded third-leg compare edge. Not a confirmed cause on hardware.
confirmed_code_gap: cm_pair_window guards only selected shunt phases and accepts an excluded-phase compare during acquisition.
planner_limits: Not integrated into timer/ADC IRQs. Must verify preload/update epoch, queue write deadlines and coverage before deployment. Keeps latest trigger4928 and rejects impossible windows; up to11% angle positions are unavailable at high modulation, exceeding installed95% accepted-sample criterion. Do not weaken that criterion just to pass.

source_config: Both ADCs: same TIM1_TRGO rising trigger, independent mode, async42.5MHz/1, 12-bit left aligned, sampling24.5cycles, one injected rank after initialization.
ADC1 phases U ch1/V ch7; ADC2 V ch7/W ch6; four separate frozen offsets.
JQM1 queue end-empty, fixed trigger, fixed length. ADC2 JEOS required; loss latches invalid.
RCR1, PWM channels preload; next-context selection is based on shadow compares. No per-sample timer epoch or physical timestamp saved.
not_proven: Actual hardware latency of both sample apertures
No queue overflow/context mismatch during a spike
Actual cause of large accepted ADC deviation
sync_review.device_revision: Rev X from archived STM32CubeProgrammer log; no new USB/SWD access
sync_review.errata_review: ES0431 Rev9: Y-only channel0 substitution and Z-only mux-switch disturbance do not apply to archived RevX. Wrong-JDR issue requires AHB/ADC>10, while configured ratio4; JQM0 queue-change issues do not match JQM1/fixed trigger/length. None of these observations proves the device fault-free.

live_evidence_limits: Peak packets carry maxima/RMS; separate rawADC snapshots are not the samples that caused maxima.
At40-50Hz peaks repeat in multiple accepted windows including windows without any rejected timing samples. CRC/sequence clean; one UART NOISE advisory does not prove a cause.
Software traces alone cannot certify analog current accuracy; persistent peaks may require independent current measurement.
next_capture_fields: rawADC1/2 around peak with channel/pair ids and actual conversion sequence id
active/planned CCR1/2/3/4, timerCNT/DIR and update epoch
ADC1/2 ISR incl JEOS/JQOVF, consumed/planned contexts, timing validity and nearest edge margin
pre/post samples around maximum, not just last rawADC
